text: 1. Personal Photos: Please upload a standard two-inch color photo with a white or blue background. Do not upload black-and-white photos, artistic photos, or self-portraits.2. Passport Information Page: You must submit a scanned copy of the information page from your ordinary passport that is valid until after January 31, 2026. If the current validity of your passport does not meet the requirements, please promptly renew it. For applicants who cannot obtain a passport before submitting the application due to objective reasons, please contact our school as soon as possible to confirm the alternative supporting documents. 3. Proof of Highest Education: Applicants who have graduated from high school should upload their "highest education certificate (graduation certificate)". For current high school graduates, upload the "expected graduation certificate", which must be issued by the school and should include the enrollment date, expected graduation date, etc.; if the "enrollment certificate" issued by the school contains the above information, it can be used as an alternative.4. Transcripts of All Courses Completed During the Highest Education Stage: Please upload the complete transcripts from the first year of high school to the current application date. The transcripts should be stamped by the school or signed by the relevant responsible person. When submitting the transcripts, it is recommended to also provide a description of the grades (including but not limited to the calculation method of GPA and the grading system for course grades).5. HSK Certificate: The validity period of HSK scores is two years (counting from the date of the examination). 6. Personal Statement: Please write in Chinese. The content should include your personal study plan, no more than 800-1000 words, and it must be signed by the applicant himself/herself.7. A Recommendation Letter: In either Chinese or English, indicate the name of the recommender's workplace, position, and contact information. The recommender must sign the letter in person. If the applicant is unable to upload the recommendation letter, please provide the relevant supporting materials in the "Recommendation Letter" section and have the recommender directly send the letter to ices@sufe.edu.cn. 8. Criminal Record Certificate: A valid criminal record certificate issued by the local public security authority must be submitted. Generally, it should be a document issued within the past 6 months prior to the application date. 9. Economic guarantee certificate and guarantor's identification document: The economic guarantor must be a natural person with full capacity for civil conduct, over 18 years old, and with a stable source of income; the economic guarantor must fill out the "Economic Guarantee Certificate" (economic guarantee certificate.pdf) truthfully and provide a scanned copy of the original passport cover page (for foreigners) or ID card (for Chinese citizens) of the guarantor.
